brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手，证完每一个目标。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.

hint.zh: 去掉 ∀ 以后，剩下的是熟悉的拆开与拼成。
hint.en: With the ∀ gone, what remains is the familiar splitting and joining.

t.zh: 逆用<part-ref to="part:allI"></part-ref> ⟦⋀x. ?P(x)⟧ ⟹ ∀x. ?P(x)：合一器解出 ?P，新目标是 ⋀a. ?P(a)。⋀ 是规则自己的「对所有」，管的是目标而不是句子：a 是任取的一样东西，目标要对它成立。
t.en: <part-ref to="part:allI"></part-ref> used backwards, ⟦⋀x. ?P(x)⟧ ⟹ ∀x. ?P(x): the unifier finds ?P, and the new goal is ⋀a. ?P(a). ⋀ is the rules’ own “for all”, ruling over goals rather than sentences: a is any thing at all, and the goal must hold of it.
